name: Simple Analytics
campaign_request: Write exactly one acquisition email in English from Simple Analytics for the selected audience. Give the reader a concrete reason to consider our product and one clear next step.

commercial_protocol.customer: Marketing lead at Simple Analytics producing acquisition campaigns
commercial_protocol.job: Find a credible audience and turn the public brand site into one reviewable acquisition email
commercial_protocol.deliverable: One email with a specific argument, sourced claims, matching CTA and usable export
commercial_protocol.input: Homepage only, defaults, first mapped audience
commercial_protocol.criterion: Would pay for repeated use if the audience and argument work saves meaningful preparation and the email is usable after ordinary review

audience_segment: A Dutch or EU public-sector web team told its site may not load Google before consent, and that a public body cannot use a cookie wall
